heading: What are Iran’s 7 conditions for peace talks?
body: As we’ve been reporting, Iran is insisting the US meet seven conditions before peace talks can begin and the Strait of Hormuz can reopen.

heading: WATCH: UK protesters reject ban on Palestine Action, demand end to arms for Israel
body: London’s Metropolitan Police have arrested more than 100 protesters outside the US embassy where they been demonstrating against the government’s proscription of the Palestine Action group as a “terrorist” organization.

heading: US senator blasts ‘Big Oil’ for profiting off war on Iran
body: Bernie Sanders has criticised oil companies for profiting off the US-Israel war on Iran at the expense of working class families.

heading: WATCH: Trump says he’s ‘not in that much of a hurry’ about Iran
body: US President Donald Trump, who says he came to his Mar-a-Lago Halloween costume party dressed as himself, described not being in a hurry to make a decision on striking Iran.

heading: IRGC says it’s ‘identifying new targets’ for attack response
body: Brigadier-General Hossein Mohebi, spokesman for the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, says recent remarks by Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei “have opened a new chapter” for Iran in any future wars.

heading: Israeli troops raid Nablus and other towns in occupied West Bank
body: Israeli forces have stormed the old city of Nablus and took up positions in the occupied West Bank.

heading: Iran says talks with US continue but wary of ‘Trump’s intentions’
body: Iran continues to hold negotiations with Washington through Qatar and other mediators but remains deeply sceptical of Trump’s intentions, a security source has told Al Jazeera.

heading: Iran deterrence strategy extends beyond regional boundaries, official says
body: Mohammad Mokhber, an adviser to Iran’s supreme leader, says the country’s defence doctrine is rapidly evolving, with Tehran no longer limiting its response to the geographical location of a threat.

heading: WATCH: Israeli attacks on Gaza kill at least nine people
IRGC claims two tankers hit mines in Hormuz
body: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has said two tankers exploded after hitting a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz, and that one of them, a supertanker, is on fire after a severe blast.

heading: ‘Diplomacy and military preparations’ ongoing simultaneously in Iran
body: Hamidreza Azizi, a senior Iran analyst with the Crisis Group, says Tehran is pursuing diplomacy while also “attempting to redefine” the military implications of another potential conflict.

heading: No ‘appetite’ in Gulf for resumption of US-Israeli war on Iran
body: For the Gulf countries, oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz are extremely important. Oil and gas are the bread and butter that fuel these economies. But we now know just how important Gulf nations and their energy supplies are to the global market.

heading: Here’s what happened today
body: We will be closing this live page shortly, but before we do, here are the main developments of the day:

heading: WATCH: What we know about latest efforts to end US war on Iran
Business owners face debt with no income amid Hebron siege
body: Al Jazeera has been hearing from Yousuf Daas, a development and labour economist with the Palestine Economic Policy Research Institute, about the economic impacts of Israel’s lockdown of Hebron.

heading: Hundreds of Palestinians families displaced as Israeli siege of Hebron continues
body: Israeli forces have forcibly displaced at least 537 Palestinian families from their homes, while many others remain trapped inside their neighbourhoods and now depend on the Red Cross for humanitarian supplies.

heading: WATCH: The price of defying AIPAC
body: This week on UpFront, Marc Lamont Hill speaks with former US Congressman Jamaal Bowman about the rise of democratic socialism, the influence of the American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC) and the political cost of his outspoken support for Palestinian rights.

heading: Nobel peace laureate says any new US strike on Iran ‘would be a blow of madness’
body: Mohamed ElBaradei, an Egyptian politician who served as the head of the United Nation’s nuclear watchdog, has warned that the Middle East will “pay a heavy price” if the US launches new attacks against Iran.

heading: WATCH: How will the Iran war shape the outcome of US midterm vote?
body: The war on Iran has emerged as a major campaign issue in the US midterm elections.

heading: Israeli army says 4 Hamas members killed in Gaza strikes
body: Four Hamas fighters were killed in recent attacks carried out in northern Gaza, Israel’s military says.

heading: If you’re just joining us
body: Here are the latest developments:

heading: At least five killed in Houthi ‘war crime’ in Yemen’s Lahij, government spokesman says
body: Yemen’s internationally recognised government has accused the Houthis of launching a ballistic missile at a health centre from territory under its control, calling the attack a “war crime”.

heading: Trump says deal with Iran ‘could happen’
body: The US president says that ⁠Iran wants to make a ‌deal to end the US-Israel war on the country and ⁠that such an ⁠agreement “could happen”.

heading: Yemen’s government working to remove obstacles to humanitarian aid
body: Yemen’s internationally recognised government says it is working to strengthen humanitarian assistance and remove obstacles facing aid organisations operating in the country.

heading: US conducts ‘defensive’ strikes on Iranian targets in Strait of Hormuz
body: The United States has conducted defensive strikes on Iranian targets in the Strait of Hormuz, a US official says, following reports of blasts on Iran’s Qeshm Island.

heading: Oil prices rise after report of US attack on Iran’s Qeshm Island
body: Oil prices rose in early trade on Tuesday following a report that the US has struck Iran’s Qeshm Island. Brent crude futures gained 48 cents, or 0.5 percent, to reach $105.25 a barrel as of 01:04 GMT.

heading: Israeli forces detain Al Jazeera correspondent in occupied West Bank
body: Israeli forces have detained Al Jazeera correspondent Montaser Nassar following a raid on his home in the town of Dura, south of Hebron, in the occupied West Bank.

heading: Yemeni government forces say they have recaptured positions in Lahij
body: Yemeni government forces have retaken positions in Lahij governorate as the Houthis intensify their attacks, our colleagues at Al Jazeera Arabic are reporting.

heading: Saudi-led coalition says drone downed over Mecca region
body: Colonel Turki al-Malki, spokesperson for the Saudi-led coalition forces, says a drone has been intercepted and destroyed over the Mecca region.

heading: Yemen armed forces claim success in 1,208 operations against Houthi gatherings and assets
body: Spokesperson for Yemen’s armed forces has said that they conducted 1,208 targeting operations against the Iran-backed Houthi gatherings, movements and vehicles in a statement on X.

heading: US Democrat says Trump ‘desperate’ after cutting $4bn in Israel aid
body: President Trump’s claim that he plans to stop providing billions of dollars in assistance annually to Israel shows he is “desperate to stave off a Blue tsunami”, US Congressman Ro Khanna says.

heading: Saudi ministers promise ‘firm’ response to any Houthi strikes
body: Saudi Arabia’s Council of Ministers says it will respond “firmly” to any attacks during ongoing hostilities with the Houthis in Yemen.

heading: Yemen government condemns IRGC, Hezbollah support for Houthis
body: Yemen’s Foreign Ministry has condemned what it called “the blatant military intervention” of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) and Hezbollah in the country.

heading: US war on Iran: What comes next?
body: What appeared to be a limited strike by the United States on Iranian targets in the Strait of Hormuz hours before Tuesday’s midterm US elections is raising questions about what’s coming next.

heading: Oil prices settle near four-week low on hopes of US-Iran peace talks
body: Oil prices eased about 1 percent to the lowest in nearly four weeks as the market weighed talks to end the wars in Ukraine and Iran.

heading: Democrat Keisha Bottoms wins election for governor in Georgia
body: Democrat Keisha Bottoms has won Georgia’s race for governor, flipping control of the battleground state.

heading: FBI arrests man for sending over 700 threatening letters to US officials
body: A man from the Midwestern United States is facing federal charges after allegedly mailing hundreds of suspicious letters containing white powder and menacing warnings about treason ahead of the midterms.

heading: Latest results
Iran war ‘must end’ says Senate Minority Leader Schumer
body: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer has blamed President Donald Trump for the party flips in key election states last night, saying the President spent “half his time talking about things that were irrelevant to [voters’] lives.”

heading: Senate Minority Leader Schumer on midterm results: ‘A generational remake of the Senate’
body: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer held a news conference on Wednesday morning after the Democrats won control of the Senate and House in the midterm elections.

heading: Photos: Palestine Action challenges UK ban in Supreme Court
body: A protester is carried away by police during a demonstration in support of Palestine Action outside the Supreme Court in London [Toby Shepheard/Reuters]

heading: VP Vance tries to distance himself from US war on Iran
body: JD Vance publicly broke from President Trump’s defence of the war on Iran after the Republican Party’s stunning midterm defeat.

heading: Stocks surge, oil plunges as Trump may now ‘be inclined’ to end war on Iran
body: Share prices rallied and crude oil prices tumbled in response to the US midterm election results that saw the Democrats seize control of both houses of the US Congress.

heading: Ro Khanna proposes ending Iran war, cutting Israel aid, releasing Epstein files
body: Democratic US Congressman Ro Khanna says he agrees with Vice President JD Vance that the reason Republicans lost in the midterms “is the Iran” war as well as “the corruption epitomised by the Epstein cover up”.

heading: Annie Andrews ‘ready to put politics aside’ for South Carolina voters
body: Democratic US Senator-elect Annie Andrews, who defeated deceased Lindsey Graham’s sister Darline on Tuesday says she’ll “work with anyone, regardless of party, to bring down costs for South Carolina families”.

heading: Former secretary of US Commerce Department calls for action against AI
body: Former US Secretary of Commerce Gina Raimondo says election results show that artificial intelligence (AI) has become a crucial issue for Americans.

heading: Iranian leaders say ‘no difference between Democrats and Republicans’
body: Reporting from Tehran, Iran

heading: Saudi Arabia’s Civil Defence issues brief danger alert for Yanbu near Red Sea
body: Saudi Arabia’s Civil Defence briefly issued an alert for Yanbu – a major coastal city in the Medina Province along the Red Sea in western Saudi Arabia – warning of a potential danger.

heading: ‘Losing gambler energy’: Ghalibaf taunts Vance over Iran war comments after election defeat
body: Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf has taunted JD Vance over his comments on the US election results.

heading: Israeli army targets Lebanon’s southern Tyre district
body: Israeli forces have attacked the town of al-Mansouri in Lebanon’s Tyre district, the National News Agency reports.

heading: Democratic majority ‘must end this disastrous war’, Bernie Sanders says
body: Progressive US Senator Bernie Sanders says ending the war on Iran and cutting off funding for Israel should be top priorities for the newly elected Democratic majority.

heading: IRGC warns any state helping US attack Iran a ‘legitimate target’
body: A top adviser for Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has warned that any state that helps the US in renewed attacks against Iran will be treated as a “legitimate target”.

heading: How the US midterms are shaping Israel’s race for PM
body: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has long sold himself as the leader who will ensure ties with the United States, the country’s most important ally, remain strong.

heading: Israeli air strike on Gaza City kills 3 Palestinians
body: Three Palestinians have been killed and several others injured after an Israeli attack on al-Shati refugee camp, west of Gaza City.

heading: Turkish parliament takes step towards ratifying defence pact with Saudi Arabia, Pakistan
body: Turkish lawmakers have approved the first article of a bill to ratify the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan, bringing the three countries closer to formalising a collective defence alliance.

heading: WATCH: US lawmaker Jason Crow says Democrats must use Congress to end US war on Iran
body: US Congressman Jason Crow, a Democrat representing Colorado, says his party’s priorities after winning control of Congress should be lowering living costs, restoring accountability and ending the war in Iran.

heading: Iran, UAE foreign ministers discuss regional developments in call
body: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and his UAE counterpart, Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan, have discussed the latest regional developments and diplomatic efforts to maintain stability.

heading: WATCH: Israeli settlers set fire to Palestinian olive grove near Ramallah
body: Israeli settlers have set fire to olive trees belonging to Palestinian farmers in the village of Burqa, near Ramallah. Farmers said Israeli forces then stopped them extinguishing the fires.

heading: WATCH: Aid groups in Gaza turn discarded cooking pots into seawalls
body: As winter approaches, aid groups in Gaza are turning damaged cooking pots into makeshift seawalls to protect shelters and schools from flooding.

heading: Siege of Taiz is ‘suffocating’ the city and province
body: Reporting from Taiz, Yemen

heading: Houthis say 67 air and missile strikes hit five Yemeni provinces in 24 hours
body: The Houthis say that 67 air and missile strikes hit five Yemeni provinces over the past 24 hours, according to a statement by their military spokesperson, Yahya Saree.

heading: Rescue workers are searching for bodies in Yemen’s al-Waziiya district
body: Reporting from Sanaa, Yemen

heading: Yemeni armed forces say Houthi missile hit market in Taiz, dozens killed or injured
body: Yemeni government armed forces say a Houthi ballistic missile hit a popular market in the city of al-Waziiya in the Taiz governorate, killing and wounding dozens of civilians.

heading: Two missiles hit Iran’s Qeshm Island: Iranian semi-official media
body: Tasnim news agency reports two missile impacts on the island, after Iran’s official news agency IRNA reported similar information a short while ago.

heading: Iranian state media says ‘aircraft sound’ heard on Qeshm Island
body: Iran’s official news agency IRNA says that locals on Qeshm Island, located in the Strait of Hormuz, reported that two projectiles “impacted in the Susa area” of the island.

heading: US sanctions Canadian money services firms over Iran-related transactions
body: ⁠The US Treasury says it has imposed sanctions on eight money services firms based in Canada ⁠⁠over allegations that they facilitated transactions with sanctioned Iranian entities.

heading: Trump says US making ‘a lot of progress’ in talks with Iran
body: US President Donald Trump says Washington has made “a lot of progress” with Iran and that Tehran wants an agreement, while claiming American forces recently destroyed an Iranian air defence system.

heading: Qatar PM says crisis ‘cannot be left unresolved’
body: Qatar’s Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani says during a public interview at Oxford University on Friday that mediation efforts remain active to prevent a major regional escalation, warning that the crisis “cannot be left unresolved.”

heading: US offers up to $20m for information on Iran’s nuclear programme
body: The US State Department’s Rewards for Justice programme is offering a reward of up to $20m and possible relocation for information about Iran’s nuclear programme, including its facilities, equipment and associated personnel.

heading: Yemeni government forces besiege major Houthi supply line in Taiz
body: Yemeni government forces have besieged the entrance of the village of al-Sarari in Taiz, cutting off a major Houthi supply line in the province, our colleagues at Al Jazeera Arabic are reporting.

heading: IRGC spokesman says it is prepared for changes to nuclear doctrine if state decides
body: We can now bring you more lines from Iran’s IRGC spokesperson, Brigadier General Hossein Mohebbi.

heading: US and Iran stuck in ‘low-intensity’ conflict as mediation continues
body: Mehran Kamrava, a professor of government at Georgetown University in Qatar, says the US and Iran are hardening their rhetoric while simultaneously engaging in serious negotiations.

heading: Baghdad ready to resolve differences with Saudi Arabia: Iraqi FM
body: Iraqi FM Hussein told Al Jazeera that Baghdad seeks to resolve its differences with Saudi Arabia “through frank dialogue”.

heading: Iraq welcomes friendship with Iran but rejects any interference in its internal affairs: Iraqi FM
body: We have some more lines from Iraq’s foreign minister, Fuad Hussein.

heading: WATCH: Heavy rain floods makeshift shelters across Gaza
body: Displaced Palestinians in Gaza have been hit by a deluge of rain, destroying their homes and and plunging many into desperate circumstances.

heading: Yemen’s armed forces claim gains made in Taiz, Lahij governorates
body: The armed forces of Yemen’s internationally backed government say in a statement on their official X account that they thwarted Houthi attacks on the “eastern fronts” of the city of Taiz, currently the site of feirce fighting.

heading: Israeli opposition leader Golan: Netanyahu’s government must be replaced
body: Israeli opposition leader Yair Golan, who leads the Democrats party, says that “Netanyahu’s government must be replaced,” and called for change “to safeguard Israel’s democracy, security, and future”.

heading: WATCH: Lebanese footballer refuses to give up after injuries from Israeli strike
body: After surviving a devastating Israeli air strike on Beirut that left her in a coma and partially paralysed, former Lebanon national footballer Celine Haidar is rebuilding her life.

heading: Buildings damaged in Israeli bombings risk collapse as rain inundates Gaza
body: Gaza City – Rana Adnan Hmeida, 29, stands at the entrance to her tent in al-Mina camp in northern Gaza, holding her two-month-old daughter as she tries to keep her warm after rainwater has flooded their shelter overnight. The family’s bedding, blankets and clothes are all soaked, with her children e

heading: Former UNRWA chief calls for ‘long-overdue’ access to humanitarian aid in Gaza
body: The former chief of the United Nations Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA), Philippe Lazzarini, has called for the “long overdue” access to humanitarian aid in Gaza.

heading: WATCH: Mélenchon promises action against Israeli annexation if elected as President
body: French presidential candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon has pledged to take direct action in support of Palestinians if elected, vowing to oppose Israel’s genocide in Gaza and annexation of the West Bank.

heading: Iranian naval commander vows to raise the ‘cost of any aggression’
body: Mohsen Razzaqi, commander of Iran’s Northern Fleet and Fourth Naval Zone, says coordination and cooperation among the branches of the country’s armed forces are at “their highest level”.

heading: Houthi official says 33 killed in Saudi strikes on village near Sanaa
body: Anees Alasbahi, a spokesperson for the Houthi Ministry of Health, says the death toll from airstrikes by Saudi-led coalition on the village of Al Shariyah has now risen to 33.

heading: WATCH: Heavy rains flood displacement camps across Gaza
body: Heavy rains and strong winds have flooded and damaged displacement tents across Gaza.
